role: A DataWatcher metadata update for one entity; for the player's own entity it carries the health field (16) the health HUD reads.

notes: In the live flow the player's health reaches the client through S06; the PK_S1C case exists so the dev-prequeued metadata form applies the same way. Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): the renderer reads server metadata (by design). Formerly listed as missing: Other entities' metadata updates (creeper swell state, sheep sheared, witch flags, the mob byte fields) have no client half; only the player's own health metadata is applied.
